scientific_integrity: Analytical large-deviation and convex minimization proof; standalone reproducibility tests are finite checks, not an independent certificate. Genuinely asymmetric angular sectors and fixed-marginal shared-rate ordering are the assessed scientific contribution.
scientific_limitations: Two independent free Brownian coordinates, three positive homogeneous Poisson streams, stationary log-tail scale, unequal individual reset intensities. No prefactors, finite-threshold domination, estimation uncertainty or general interactions. Symmetric homogeneous batch resetting already established in prior literature.
title: Anisotropic joint-excursion rates under asymmetric shared and individual Brownian resetting
